sections.title: Beyond Climate — Other Major EU News

items.title: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy speaks at EU summit amid spat with Donald Trump
items.description: EU leaders reaffirmed support for Ukraine at the Brussels summit. But souring relations with the US over Russia and Starlink and a big hole in the budget will make for a difficult winter for Ukraine.

items.title: At summit, EU leaders pledge support for Ukraine's Zelenskyy
items.description: President Zelenskyy has received words of encouragement from EU leaders, who pledged support for Ukraine's self-defense against Russia. This comes as winter approaches and the US seems to be withdrawing support.

items.title: EU promotes sovereign, trusted AI as it struggles to catch US and China
items.description: At an international AI summit in Dublin, EU leaders promoted trusted and independent artificial intelligence. Critics question whether the bloc can close the gap with the US and China while maintaining strict regulation.

items.title: Germany, France agree on deal to support Europe's struggling car industry
items.description: The two countries said the agreement aimed to safeguard Europe's automotive industry, encouraging development and research. Automakers in Europe have so far struggled to compete with Chinese electric car companies.
